name: @lumithink/dsh-a2a-client
description: P2-02 (issue #114) LumiThink DSH A2A Client: official @a2a-js/sdk@1.3.0 lightweight client adapter for the external working DSH. Implements the ADR-0018 five hard constraints (credential binding via the official AuthenticationHandler face, persistent messageId/taskId ledger before-send and on-arrival, independent cancel context per TASK_LIFECYCLE §7.4, §5.3 first-response-loss recovery, structured input-required/auth-required handles). External client boundary only: no household database access, no internal runtime, no UDS. Synthetic data only; no real credentials; not the working-DSH production registration (operator-side work, PENDING).

scripts.test: node --test --test-isolation=none tests/ledger.spec.ts tests/config.spec.ts tests/client-send.spec.ts tests/client-cancel.spec.ts tests/client-multiturn.spec.ts tests/client-recovery.spec.ts tests/client-auth.spec.ts tests/client-stream.spec.ts
